description: CIRCA classification evaluation cases. Evaluation data only: never loaded as knowledge and never copied into team/incidents.json. The 35 synthetic retrieval cases in src/circa/data/retrieval_evaluation.json are evaluated alongside these as the legacy baseline.
labeling_conventions: label_status 'confirmed' means the label comes from a human-verified source named in label_note, or is synthetic by construction. 'pending_review' labels were assigned from explicit log evidence and are reported separately until a person confirms them. relevant_incident_ids names only packaged incidents that directly describe the case; an empty list means none is known. expected_root_cause_terms are words a correct root cause must all contain (case-insensitive); an empty list means the root cause is not labeled.
